title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Premium Revision Paper #6

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is Ganga jal? (1 mark)
   A. A book
   B. Water from the River Ganga
   C. A kind of tree
   D. A festival

2. Which plant is the holy basil? (1 mark)
   A. Beri
   B. Peepal
   C. Tulsi
   D. Sal

3. Which time of day is best for watering plants? (1 mark)
   A. Any time in the hottest sun
   B. Noon
   C. Early morning or evening
   D. Midnight

4. Where do Hindu families often grow Tulsi? (1 mark)
   A. Under the roof
   B. In the kitchen fire
   C. Only in a river
   D. In a pot or raised stand in the courtyard

5. Which Sanskrit word means water? (1 mark)
   A. Prithvi
   B. Agni
   C. Vayu
   D. Jal

6. How did Prahlad react when his father was angry? (1 mark)
   A. He ran away forever
   B. He stayed calm and kept his faith
   C. He became cruel
   D. He gave up praying

7. What did the wise men say about the swan? (1 mark)
   A. It belongs to the king
   B. The one who shoots it owns it
   C. The one who saves a life has more right to it
   D. It should be sold

8. What does Aparigraha mean? (1 mark)
   A. Always be angry
   B. Take everything
   C. Do not be greedy or hold too many things
   D. Talk a lot

9. What rescue is Parshvanath known for in a well-known story? (1 mark)
   A. A drowning child
   B. A wounded swan
   C. A snake in a burning log
   D. A lost cow

10. What did Siddhartha later become? (1 mark)
   A. A Jain Tirthankar
   B. An Avtar of Vishnu
   C. A Sikh Guru
   D. The Buddha, the Awakened One

11. Which teaching is linked with Guru Ram Das Ji? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Wealth only
   C. Equality and serving others
   D. War

12. Where was Prince Siddhartha born? (1 mark)
   A. Lumbini
   B. Varanasi
   C. Lahore
   D. Amritsar

13. For how many years was Ram asked to live in the forest? (1 mark)
   A. Fifty
   B. Five
   C. Fourteen
   D. Two

14. In what language was the Ramayan first written? (1 mark)
   A. Kiswahili
   B. Sanskrit
   C. Gurmukhi
   D. English

15. When is the Gayatri Mantra a good prayer to say? (1 mark)
   A. Never
   B. Only at the market
   C. Before studying
   D. Only in the night

16. What should you do with your shoes before entering a Mandir? (1 mark)
   A. Carry them inside
   B. Throw them
   C. Wear them
   D. Remove them

17. What does the Gayatri Mantra ask for? (1 mark)
   A. A big house
   B. Rain
   C. Wisdom
   D. Money

18. How can children with speech difficulties join prayers at assembly? (1 mark)
   A. They must not attend
   B. By leaving
   C. By shouting
   D. By humming or listening

19. Amina pays Ksh 200 for sugar costing Ksh 150 and is given Ksh 100 change. How much extra did she get? (1 mark)
   A. Ksh 50
   B. Ksh 200
   C. Ksh 150
   D. Ksh 100

20. Which is dishonest? (1 mark)
   A. Owning up to a mistake
   B. Returning a lost item
   C. Copying another person's work and calling it your own
   D. Doing your own homework

21. What does Asteya include besides not stealing things? (1 mark)
   A. Not using another's time or ideas without asking
   B. Not smiling
   C. Not walking
   D. Not eating

22. Who was Bhai Lalo? (1 mark)
   A. A Jain monk
   B. A shopkeeper in Nairobi
   C. An honest carpenter in the Guru Nanak story
   D. A king of Ayodhya

23. What does Vajra mean in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. Moon
   B. Bellows
   C. Diamond or thunderbolt
   D. Hare

24. How do you sit in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. Sit cross-legged
   B. Kneel and sit on your heels
   C. Stand on your hands
   D. Lie down

25. What should you do if you feel dizzy during yoga? (1 mark)
   A. Hold your breath
   B. Stop at once
   C. Continue faster
   D. Ignore it

26. Which statement is true about kindness? (1 mark)
   A. It includes animals and nature
   B. It is only for humans
   C. It is only for adults
   D. It is only for rich people

27. According to Hindu belief, what does the soul do after death? (1 mark)
   A. Ends forever
   B. Turns to stone
   C. Turns into a tree only
   D. Takes a new body

28. How should we treat others who hold different beliefs about death? (1 mark)
   A. Laugh
   B. Argue
   C. Listen with respect
   D. Ignore them

29. What does karma mean? (1 mark)
   A. Water
   B. Prayer
   C. Action
   D. Wealth

30. Which is a kind of prayer? (1 mark)
   A. A song of prayer called a bhajan
   B. A market
   C. A school race
   D. A race

31. What does Purushartha mean? (1 mark)
   A. A river
   B. A festival
   C. The goals of life
   D. A prayer

32. Which Purushartha is about doing our duty and living rightly? (1 mark)
   A. Artha
   B. Dharma
   C. Kama
   D. Moksha

33. In the Shibi story, what did the hawk want? (1 mark)
   A. A crown
   B. Water
   C. A house
   D. The dove as food

34. How can we help a friend who uses a wheelchair at a festival? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore them
   B. Help them to move safely and include them
   C. Leave them alone
   D. Laugh

35. Which national symbol is raised at Madaraka Day ceremonies? (1 mark)
   A. A sail
   B. A flag of a sports team
   C. The national flag
   D. The school flag

36. Which is a memory trick for the seven names? (1 mark)
   A. Skipping them
   B. Reading backwards only
   C. Making a rhyme or song
   D. Writing them once

37. Som is another name for which heavenly body? (1 mark)
   A. The Sun
   B. The Moon
   C. Saturn
   D. Jupiter

38. How many days are in the week in the Indian traditional calendar? (1 mark)
   A. Eight
   B. Six
   C. Five
   D. Seven

39. What is the Indian name for Thursday? (1 mark)
   A. Shanivaar
   B. Ravivaar
   C. Guruvaar
   D. Shukravaar

40. Which planet is called the red planet? (1 mark)
   A. Venus
   B. Mars
   C. Jupiter
   D. Saturn

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. How can you learn more about the scriptures? Give four ways. (4 marks)

42. State four ways of caring for plants and water. (4 marks)

43. Name the four Purusharthas. (2 marks)

44. State two reasons why trees and plants are important. (2 marks)

45. Match the days to the heavenly bodies: Ravivaar, Somvaar, Mangalvaar. (3 marks)

46. Explain how you would present a short skit on one Enlightened Being. (4 marks)

47. Describe how Hindu families care for the Tulsi plant. (3 marks)

48. Describe how to make a decorated calendar. (4 marks)

49. Explain how learners can include friends with special needs in yoga. (5 marks)

50. Describe the early life of Sri Guru Ram Das Ji. (4 marks)

51. List the five principles of Dharma studied in the lesson. (2 marks)

52. Write the Indian names for Thursday and Friday. (2 marks)

53. Choose one teaching from an Enlightened Being and say how you can follow it at school. (3 marks)

54. Explain how the four faiths in this lesson teach integrity. (5 marks)

55. State three ways of showing respect to the National flag and Anthem. (3 marks)

56. Write the Indian names for Tuesday and Wednesday. (2 marks)

57. Explain how the days of the week are related to the solar system. (3 marks)

58. Choose one scripture and explain how a child can apply its teaching at home and at school. (5 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #6 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Water from the River Ganga
   Jal means water, so Ganga jal is water from the Ganga.

2. C — Tulsi
   Tulsi is the holy basil plant.

3. C — Early morning or evening
   Less water dries up in cooler hours.

4. D — In a pot or raised stand in the courtyard
   The stand is called the Tulsi Vrindavan.

5. D — Jal
   Jal (also Apas) means water.

6. B — He stayed calm and kept his faith
   Prahlad kept his faith without fear.

7. C — The one who saves a life has more right to it
   They said saving life is a greater right.

8. C — Do not be greedy or hold too many things
   Aparigraha is non-greed.

9. C — A snake in a burning log
   He asked the man to stop and the snake was saved.

10. D — The Buddha, the Awakened One
   Siddhartha became the Buddha.

11. C — Equality and serving others
   He taught that all people are equal and service is important.

12. A — Lumbini
   Lumbini is now in Nepal.

13. C — Fourteen
   Kaikeyi asked that Ram go for fourteen years.

14. B — Sanskrit
   It was written in Sanskrit by Valmiki.

15. C — Before studying
   It is a prayer for wisdom.

16. D — Remove them
   Shoes are removed to keep it clean and show respect.

17. C — Wisdom
   It asks that the divine light guide our minds.

18. D — By humming or listening
   Everyone can take part in their own way.

19. A — Ksh 50
   Correct change is 50, so 100 minus 50 is 50 extra.

20. C — Copying another person's work and calling it your own
   Copying and claiming it is cheating.

21. A — Not using another's time or ideas without asking
   It includes respecting others' things and ideas.

22. C — An honest carpenter in the Guru Nanak story
   Bhai Lalo earned by honest work.

23. C — Diamond or thunderbolt
   Vajra means diamond or thunderbolt.

24. B — Kneel and sit on your heels
   You sit on your heels.

25. B — Stop at once
   Stop and rest.

26. A — It includes animals and nature
   Kindness includes all living beings.

27. D — Takes a new body
   This is rebirth.

28. C — Listen with respect
   Respect for others is a value.

29. C — Action
   Karma is action and its results.

30. A — A song of prayer called a bhajan
   Bhajans are sung prayers.

31. C — The goals of life
   Purushartha means the goals of a person's life.

32. B — Dharma
   Dharma is right living.

33. D — The dove as food
   The hawk demanded the dove.

34. B — Help them to move safely and include them
   Inclusion is important.

35. C — The national flag
   The flag is raised and the anthem sung.

36. C — Making a rhyme or song
   Songs help us remember.

37. B — The Moon
   Som is the Moon.

38. D — Seven
   Seven days.

39. C — Guruvaar
   Guru is Jupiter.

40. B — Mars
   Mars is the red planet.

SECTION B
----
41. (4 marks)
   Answer: Listen to a resource person, visit a temple or library, discuss with friends, watch a documentary, use a safe search engine with an adult (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Plant a tree or Tulsi, water plants early or late in the day, collect rainwater, close taps and mend leaks, and never throw plastic into rivers (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct way.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Dharma, Artha, Kama, Moksha.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: They give oxygen, shade, food and medicine; their leaves are used in worship (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sun, Moon, Mars.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: Choose a story, decide the characters, practise the lines, act it out, and then say what lesson it teaches.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for choosing the story, roles, practice, acting and lesson (any four).

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: They grow it in a pot or a stand in the courtyard, water it every morning, walk around it and pray. Its leaves are offered to Vishnu and Krishna and used in home medicine.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point, up to 3.

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: Draw a table with seven columns, write English and Indian names, draw the Sun, Moon and planets above their days, and decorate it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

49. (5 marks)
   Answer: They can do breathing slowly, take seated poses, help hold the chart or take photos, and be encouraged by their partners. Everyone's effort is respected.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four points and 1 mark for respect.

50. (4 marks)
   Answer: He was born in Lahore with the childhood name Jetha, lost his parents young, helped his family by selling boiled grain, and later served Guru Amar Das Ji.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point, up to 4.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: Paramatma, Purushartha, Prani Daya, Punarjanam, Prarthana (any correct set earns marks).
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each, rounded up.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: Thursday: Guruvaar. Friday: Shukravaar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

53. (3 marks)
   Answer: Any sensible answer, for example Ahimsa: I will not bully or hurt classmates, and I will care for plants.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the being, 1 mark for the teaching, 1 mark for a clear action.

54. (5 marks)
   Answer: Hinduism: truth (Harishchandra). Sikhism: honest earnings (Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo). Jainism: not stealing (Asteya). Buddhism: right speech and not stealing or lying.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each faith and 1 mark for a summary.

55. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stand straight, be quiet, never let the flag touch the ground, learn and sing the anthem (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

56. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tuesday: Mangalvaar. Wednesday: Budhvaar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: They are named after the Sun, the Moon and five planets that people could see in the sky, so each day has a heavenly partner.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for Sun and Moon, planets and naming.

58. (5 marks)
   Answer: Any correct scripture with a clear lesson and two examples, for example Ramayan: keep promises at home by helping with chores and at school by returning a book on time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for scripture, 1 mark for lesson, 1 mark each for home and school examples, 1 mark for clarity.
